passages.title: Anna's Sunday Morning
passages.text: Anna usually gets up late on Sundays. She does not go to work, so she can relax. This morning, she wakes up at ten o'clock. She feels happy because the sun is shining. First, she makes a cup of coffee and drinks it in the kitchen. Then, she reads a book for an hour. At twelve, she decides to go to the park. She puts on her favorite dress and takes her dog, Max, with her. In the park, she meets her friend Tom. They walk together and talk about their week. After an hour, Anna feels hungry. She buys a sandwich from a small shop. She sits on a bench and eats it while Max plays nearby. At two o'clock, she goes home. She thinks it is a perfect Sunday.
